about_short_description.short_description: National Bank of Oman is a bank which offers Personal banking, SME banking and Wholesale banking.

product.name: Personal Banking Accounts and Deposits
product.description: Current, savings, children’s, youth, retiree, privilege and priority accounts, supported by long-term deposit options and deposit-rate information.

product.name: Personal Loans and Financing
product.description: Consumer financing for housing, vehicles and personal needs, including Home Loans, the Iskan Home Financing Program, Personal Loans and Car Loans.

product.name: Cards and Payment Plans
product.description: Credit, debit, business credit and Badeel prepaid cards for purchases, cash access and controlled spending, with an Easy Payment Plan option.

product.name: Digital and Self-Service Banking
product.description: Mobile and internet banking, phone banking, mobile wallets, Apple Pay, Samsung Wallet, ATMs, cash and cheque deposit machines, and self-service kiosks.

product.name: SME Banking
product.description: Banking services for small and medium-sized enterprises, covering business accounts, financing, payments and other operational banking needs.

product.name: Wholesale and Corporate Banking
product.description: Corporate and wholesale banking services including distribution and transaction banking, cash management, corporate internet banking and business cards.
